name: target_only
strengths: Lowest input complexity and guaranteed availability

name: all_dynamic
strengths: Uses every declared dynamic covariate without selection
weaknesses: Known to harm a nontrivial calibration fraction

name: binary_best_constant
strengths: Simple leakage-safe selection with guaranteed coverage
selection_reason: Tests whether a larger policy set is needed

name: fullset_best_constant
strengths: Strong fixed-policy comparator using the same candidate set
selection_reason: First fixed-sequence comparator and inapplicable-group fallback

name: last_origin_winner
weaknesses: High variance and ignores longer history
selection_reason: Checks whether exponential aggregation adds value

name: ungated_ewm_router
paper_title: EWM historical-utility router without applicability certificate
strengths: Identical dynamic router without the proposed group certificate
weaknesses: Routes in groups where signal is unreliable
selection_reason: Directly isolates the core applicability contribution

name: applicability_gated_router
strengths: Routes only where calibration evidence is certified and otherwise uses a strong constant
selection_reason: Method under test rather than a baseline

name: finite_candidate_oracle
strengths: Measures remaining headroom within the exact candidate set
weaknesses: Uses evaluation outcomes and is not deployable

name: random_policy
strengths: Detects accidental gains from candidate-set composition
selection_reason: Appendix negative control if compute is already available

name: unweighted_history_router
paper_title: Mean historical-utility router without recency decay
weaknesses: Not covered by the P1a signal certificate

name: ChronosX
paper_title: ChronosX: Adapting Pretrained Time Series Models with Exogenous Variables
weaknesses: Changes model parameters and is not a matched native-input policy decision
selection_reason: Related work rather than a fair main baseline

name: CoRA
paper_title: CoRA: Covariate-Aware Adaptation of Time Series Foundation Models
weaknesses: Different adaptation setting and unavailable matched two-backbone protocol

name: TFMAdapter
paper_title: Instance-level Adaptation of Time Series Foundation Models for Covariates
weaknesses: Trains an adapter and does not isolate native input routing
